test_problems_simple: test the problems.simple function that builds a loss graph computing f(x) = x^2
test_problems_simple_multi_optimizer: test the problems.simple_multi_optimizer function with configurable number of dimensions
test_problems_quadratic: test the problems.quadratic function that builds a loss graph for ||Wx - y||^2
test_problems_ensemble: test the problems.ensemble function that combines multiple problems with optional weights
run_problems_test_suite: run the problems_test test suite using tf.test.main to execute all problem tests
